title: CSOAI Refund / Chargeback Record
description: A deterministic, append-only record of a refund or chargeback event. Revokes the named entitlement and any Ed25519 certificate issued under it. Never invents fields the source did not supply — absent data is null, never substituted.

refund_id.description: Stable identifier; sha256 of canonical body bytes (per existing receipt convention).

observed_at.description: When the refund was observed by CSOAI (NOT when the buyer initiated it — that comes from source.timestamp_buyer).

reference.description: Channel-specific stable ID: Paddle event id, operator action id, buyer ticket id, dispute resolution id.

timestamp_buyer.description: When the buyer initiated the refund — supplied by the channel, not invented here.

amount.description: Refund amount in the currency of the original settlement. Required for chargebacks; null if the channel does not supply it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Required for chargebacks; null if the channel does not supply it.

entitlement.description: The entitlement granted by the original settlement. Revoked iff revoked: true.

cert.description: The Ed25519 certificate issued under the entitlement. Revoked iff revoked: true.

doctrine.description: Free-text doctrine annotations. Never authoritative — descriptive only.

idempotency_key.description: sha256 of canonical source-block bytes. Same refund through the same channel twice produces the same key, so retry is idempotent.
